summary: Checkpoint verification reports completed phase timings and process I/O in structured journal lines and the latest verification_attempt status table, including input_digest scans on failed-input retries (see #5127).

rules.detail: Verification decisions and stopping conditions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Status JSON adds optional verification_attempt metadata; older JSON remains readable. Attempts are process-local and reset on restart.

manual.detail: Each completed phase reports wall_ms and Linux /proc/self/io read_bytes/write_bytes deltas. These are kernel-accounted process I/O, not device traffic or isolated verification I/O: concurrent work and filesystem caching affect interpretation. Unsupported platforms or unavailable counters report null. Plan count means dropped claims; reader counts mean subjects compared. d3_iterations counts executed fixpoint passes (zero for a cached plan). proof_copy reports clone or vacuum_into. Failed attempts retain completed phases, not fabricated remaining phases.
